mcat_description.short: Roof structural fabrication services cover the design, fabrication, and on-site installation of steel roof structures — including trusses, purlins, rafters, and roofing sheet fixing — for industrial sheds, warehouses, commercial buildings, and farm structures. Services are typically quoted per sq ft and executed as turnkey contracts by structural fabricators.
mcat_description.long: Roof structural fabrication services encompass the end-to-end engineering, shop fabrication, and field erection of steel roof structures for low-rise industrial and commercial buildings, designed and executed as per IS 800:2007 (General Construction in Steel) and IS 875 (load analysis for dead, live, and wind loads). The primary structural system comprises mild steel (MS) or tubular steel trusses, portal frames, and purlins fabricated from IS 2062 E250/E350 grade steel, with roofing completed using GI, galvalume, colour-coated, or PUF sandwich panels. Services range from conventional truss-and-purlin systems for small sheds to pre-engineered building (PEB) roofing structures for large-span warehouses and factories, with each project custom-designed to span, load, slope, and site wind zone requirements. Buyers in the Indian B2B market include industrial shed owners, warehouse developers, contractors, poultry and farm shed builders, and institutional project managers who procure these services on a per-sq-ft or lump-sum basis.

market_context: Roof structural fabrication services in India constitute a large, fragmented B2B market dominated by small and medium structural fabricators operating regionally, with strong concentration in South India (Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana) and Maharashtra. The governing design standard is IS 800:2007 (General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice), which mandates the Limit State Method (LSM) for all structural steel design including trusses, portal frames, and purlins; load analysis is performed per IS 875 (Parts 1–3) covering dead, live, and wind loads. Material procurement follows IS 2062 E250/E350 grade hot-rolled structural steel for conventional trusses, with IS 806 applicable for tubular steel sections. Two dominant structural systems compete in the Indian market: (1) conventional mild steel (MS) truss-and-purlin systems, which are cost-effective for spans up to ~20m and widely used for small industrial sheds and farm structures; and (2) pre-engineered building (PEB) systems, which offer column-free spans and faster erection for large warehouses and factories. Roofing sheet materials include GI (galvanised iron), galvalume, colour-coated steel sheets (from brands such as JSW, Jindal, SAIL), and PUF sandwich panels for insulated applications. Buyers evaluate fabricators on span capability, IS compliance documentation, material grade certification, coating/finish quality, and erection timeline. The keyword signal 'teen set' (Hindi for GI sheet set) indicates a significant buyer segment that procures roofing as a bundled material-plus-labour package rather than a pure service contract.
